title: AU Credit Cards Karwa Chauth Offer – Get Up to ₹20,000 Amazon Vouchers on Jewellery Spends
snippet: AU Bank keeps coming up with innovative offers and deals, especially on gold and diamond purchases. Now, AU Bank credit card holders can earn Amazon vouchers worth up to ₹20,000 on jewellery purchases this Karwa Chauth. You can easily save up to 4% on your jewellery purchases.
